full_title: Smart Evidence-based Triangulation for Uncovering Anomalies in MPLADS
problem_statement_title: AI/ML-Powered Early Detection of Anomalies, Fund Leakages, and Collusion Rings in MPLADS Project Lifecycles
ministry: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
theme: Smart Governance / Public Transparency / AI & ML
core_thesis: Shift public audit intervention from an 18-month post-mortem CAG report to a sub-200ms pre-sanction decision-support gate, triangulating 8 independent forensic models across financial, spatial, procurement, and network dimensions.
